cases.name: a doc comment before a field's key is its description
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: the text loses its stars, its first space and its trailing white space
empty lines at the ends are dropped, and an inner one is kept
cases.source:
type Place = {/**

 A.
 *
 B.

 */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: text on one line with no space
cases.source: type Place = {/**The city.*/ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: of two doc comments in a row, the last attaches
cases.source: type Place = {/** First. */ /** The city. */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: a line comment between, and the doc comment does not attach
cases.source:
type Place = {/** The city. */ // a note
 city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: an ordinary block comment between, and the doc comment does not attach
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ /* a note */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: an ordinary block comment is no description
cases.source: type Place = {/* The city. */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: an empty doc comment is no description
cases.source: type Place = {/** */ city: string, /***/ n: int}; const w: Place = {city: "a", n: 1}; w

cases.name: /**/ is an ordinary comment
cases.source: type Place = {/**/ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: a doc comment that stands before no field attaches nothing
cases.source: type Place = {city: string /** After. */}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: a key that is a string
cases.source: type Place = {/** Full name. */ "first name": string}; const w: Place = {"first name": "a"}; w

cases.name: an optional field
cases.source: type Place = {/** A note. */ note?: string}; const w: Place = {}; w

cases.name: descriptions at any depth
cases.source: type Item = {/** The user. */ user: {/** Their name. */ name: string, /** Tags. */ tags: {/** A label. */ label: string}[]}}; const t: Item = {user: {name: "a", tags: []}}; t

cases.name: a field of type never drops its description
cases.source: type Place = {/** Never. */ gone?: never, city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: a description beside anyOf
cases.source: type Place = {/** Maybe. */ m: int | null}; const w: Place = {m: null}; w

cases.name: a description beside a reference
cases.source: type Tree = {/** The first child. */ first: Tree | null, /** The children. */ kids: Tree[]}; const t: {/** The root. */ root: Tree} = {root: {first: null, kids: []}}; t

cases.name: a description with quotes and a non-ASCII letter
cases.source: type Place = {/** Say "hé". */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; w

cases.name: a type line's, a const line's and a parameter's descriptions are not written
cases.source: /** A report. */ type Place = {city: string}; /** One. */ const w: Place = {city: "a"}; const f = (/** The input. */ x: Place): Place => x; f(w)

cases.name: a doc comment changes no value
cases.source: /** One. */ const a = 1; a /** between */ + /** x */ 2

cases.name: declared type text: a variable's type
cases.source: x

cases.name: declared type text: a named type of the environment
cases.source: x

cases.name: declared type text: the result of a signature

functions.weather: (/** A city. */ city: string) => {/** Degrees Celsius. */ temp: float}

cases.source: weather("Paris")

cases.name: declared type text: the result of a method
cases.source: tok.info()

cases.name: as gives the type's descriptions
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; blob as Place

cases.name: is narrows to the type, with its descriptions
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; blob is Place ? [blob] : []

cases.name: a read keeps the descriptions inside the field's type
cases.source: type Item = {inner: {/** Degrees. */ temp: float}}; const t: Item = {inner: {temp: 1.5}}; t.inner

cases.name: an element of a list keeps them
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const ws: Place[] = []; ws[0]

cases.name: filter keeps them
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const ws: Place[] = []; ws.filter(w => w.city != "")

cases.name: a Join of two records drops them, even of one type
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const a: Place = {city: "a"}; const b: Place = {city: "b"}; c ? a : b

cases.name: a Join of a record and null keeps them
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const a: Place = {city: "a"}; c ? a : null

cases.name: a Join with the empty list keeps them
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const ws: Place[] = []; c ? ws : []

cases.name: a spread keeps the fields it takes from one source
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; {...w, n: 1}

cases.name: a spread keeps an optional field that only the right operand gives
cases.source: type Note = {/** A note. */ note?: string}; const w: Note = {}; {...w}

cases.name: a field of a map literal has none
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; {city: w.city}

cases.name: a map literal's field keeps the descriptions of its value's type
cases.source: type Place = {/** The city. */ city: string}; const w: Place = {city: "a"}; {w}

cases.source: x

cases.source: x

cases.source: rate("EUR")

cases.source: x
